start_here: Say to your AI: "Show every course I offer." It runs tool:read-the-courses and shows one card per course.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of its own: it reads the courses table of the pursuit database you name and changes nothing.
instructions: 1. Name the pursuit database that holds the rows, such as example_for_who_uses_it; the computer opens it with the read login its vault holds.
2. Say what you want in plain words; your AI calls tools:run with tool tool:read-the-courses and the input.
3. Read the answer: every course with its title, category, short description and picture. Show it with the screen the tool names.

worked_examples.title: List the courses
worked_examples.given: The database holds the rows the read names (made-up values).
